user.title: Away Mode Setup
user.description: Configure presence simulation to make your home look occupied while you're away.

data_description.name: A name for this Away Mode instance. Shown as the device name, so you can run several (e.g. Downstairs, Upstairs).
data_description.entities: Select lights, switches, fans, and media players to include in the simulation. These will be turned on and off at random intervals to simulate someone being home.
data_description.start_type: Choose when the simulation window begins each day. Sunset adjusts automatically with the seasons.
data_description.end_type: Choose when the simulation window ends each day. All simulated entities will be turned off at this time.
data_description.intensity: Controls how active the house appears. Low: max 20% of entities on, long gaps between changes. Medium: max 35% on, moderate gaps. High: max 50% on, frequent changes.

time_details.title: Custom Time Settings
time_details.description: Set the exact times for your simulation window. Times are in your Home Assistant configured timezone.

data_description.custom_start_time: The time each day when the simulation should begin.
data_description.custom_end_time: The time each day when the simulation should end and all entities turn off.

error.no_entities: Please select at least one entity to simulate.
error.missing_start_time: Please specify a custom start time.
error.missing_end_time: Please specify a custom end time.

abort.already_configured: Away Mode is already configured. Use the options flow to change settings.
